svg.text: 568-70.9001 sheet 5 (redrawn): electromagnets, cut clutch, signals for the PLC, auxiliary relays K1 and K2
(20) signals for the PLC (SIGNÁLY PRO PCL, sic)
(21) saddle position, front S24, rear S27
(24) auxiliary relays K1 - control of Y3, K2 -
- The contacts of KM6 on this sheet carry the cross-reference (4:16) as printed; the KM6 coil is at 4:17.
- PLC OUT-9 -> 13KM8 [?]: the cabinet photo shows about four output wires among OUT-8 to OUT-D, their positions not read (on-site check).
- 32X10 is printed at 5:13 (wire from BMR1 23) and at 5:14 (wire from 33X10, sheet 6): two wires on terminal 32.
- Y3 (air cushion): the operating manual p.42 says it is controlled by the inverter UZ1; this sheet: PLC OUT-9 -> KM8 13-14 -> K1, K1 switches Y3 on sheet 2 (on-site check).
- Y01, Y14, Y10 ends are printed + and -; Y11 ends 1/2 and every diode and RC end are this redraw's names. V10 = two Zener diodes back to back, in series with R10, the pair across Y10.
- Zone borders follow the columns of each zone's devices; the printed zone borders of this sheet were not measured.

- ink: blue Russian notes on the annotated copy (20261113_212552), not print: under Y01 "Блокир. шестерни" (gear blocking), under Y11 "гидрораспр." (hydraulic distributor), under Y10 "сцепление" (clutch).

- The earth terminal is printed twice, ⏚X10 at column 01 (Y01) and at column 06 (Y11), each to ⏚ (2:01); the netlist has one X10 PE terminal and one X10 PE -> PE row (line 86), so column 06 repeats it.
- "+14V" is printed on the line from BMR1 26 (through R14 on sheet 7) to 20X10. Under K1 and K2, at the bottom: their contact lists as printed.
Devices on this sheet (from control_devices.csv; [?] = unclear, estimated = with likely error)
UG50 [sure] rectified and AC control supplies +27V +24V +33V ~24V ~48V (PLOŠNÝ SPOJ SE ZDROJI UG50); terminals 1-32; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 3, column 03-04
X10 [sure] terminal strip in the cabinet (1-6 to M1) (SVORKOVNICE V ROZVADĚČI); 45 terminals + 3 PE (photo); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 2, column 04-09
X5 [sure] working-earth strip: 0 V of all control supplies, bonded to PE (SVORKOVNICE PRAC. ZEMĚ); terminal numbers not printed; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 2, column 02
PE [sure] earthing (protective earth) strip: XC3 T1 X10 X11 XC7 UZ1 (UZEMŇOVACÍ SVORKOVNICE (earth symbol)); earth symbol "(2:01)"; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 2, column 01-02
BMR1 [sure] cut-control module: two-hand start, knife lock, clutch contactors, cut-done signal (MODUL ŘÍZENÍ ŘEZU (PŘIPOJENÍ MODULU ŘÍZENÍ ŘEZU BMR1); RU релейный модуль управления
реза); one relay board, plate "BMR2" (photo 143021), maker not printed or seen; terminals 1-29, 0V (-), +24V (+); OM list 10.2 "BMR.." 900 010 0714; place: cabinet; device row: sheet
S5 [sure] belt-pulley cover interlock (KONCOVÝ SPÍNAČ – BLOKOVÁNÍ KRYTU ŘEMENICE; red ink on sheet 1 "у маховика" (at the flywheel)); NC 21-22 (4:10), NO 13-14 (5:09); place: machine;
Q2 [sure] M1 run switch; contacts 1-2..7-8 closed in 0, 9-10 closed in 1; photo: 16 A 660 V AC, IEC 947-3; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4-6, column 08; 17; 16; 09; 14-15
KM8 [sure] blower (air cushion) motor contactor (STYKAČ MOTORU DMYCHADLA KM8); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 12
KM6 [sure] cut clutch contactor (STYKAČE SPOJKY ŘEZU KM6, KM7); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 17
KM7 [sure] cut clutch contactor (STYKAČE SPOJKY ŘEZU KM6, KM7); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 19
Y01 [sure] knife-lock magnet: withdraws the locking pin (ELEKTROMAGNET ZAJIŠTĚNÍ NOŽE Y01; RU электромагнит фиксации ножа; blue ink on sheet 5 "Блокир. шестерни" (gear blocking)); +27 V
DC switched by BMR1 21-22; OM list 10.1: EVS 4217-PO; place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 02
V01 [sure] diode across Y01; 1N 4002 (sheet-box 5); place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 02
Y14 [sure] clamp brake: released while energized (BRZDA LISOVADLA Y14; RU тормоз прижима); "+14V" printed on its line: 2UG50 +27V through R14 11R/25W and BMR1 25-26; OM list 10.1:
556-15.0000 (MS 115); place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 04
V14 [sure] diode across Y14; 1N 4002 (sheet-box 5); place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 04
Y11 [sure] hydraulics magnet (clamping) (ELEKTROMAGNETY HYDRAULIKY Y11; RU электромагнит гидравлики); ~48 V AC from 18UG50 through KM6 3-4; OM list 10.1: EVJ 4132; place: machine;
RC11 [sure] RC suppressor across Y11; 2µ2 + 220R (sheet-box 5); place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 07
Y10 [sure] cut clutch (with brake) (SPOJKA ŘEZU Y10; RU электромагнитная муфта реза; blue ink on sheet 5 "сцепление"); +33 V DC from 10UG50 through KM6 5-6 and KM7 6-5; OM list 10.1:
591-04.0000 (MS 115); place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 10
V10 [sure] Zener diode pair across Y10 (in series with R10); 2x KZ 751 (sheet-box 5); place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 10
R10 [sure] resistor across Y10 (in series with V10); 100R/6W (sheet-box 5); place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 10
S19 [sure] cut clutch switch (for knife change) (SPÍNAČ SPOJKY ŘEZU (PRO VÝMĚNU NOŽE); red ink on sheet 1 "у маховика"); NO 13-14 (5:09), NC 21-22 (6:18); diamond actuator symbol;
place: machine; device row: sheet 5-6, column 09; 18
S24 [sure] saddle position limit switch, front position (KONCOVÝ SPÍNAČ POLOHY SEDLA – PŘEDNÍ POLOHA); NC 21-22, roller lever; OM list 10.1: Telemecanique XCK-A 102; place: machine;
S27 [sure] saddle position reference switch, rear position (REFERENČNÍ SPÍNAČ POLOHY SEDLA – ZADNÍ POLOHA); NC 21-22, roller lever; OM list 10.1: Telemecanique XCK-A 102; place:
S30 [sure] clamp position sensor (top position) (SNÍMAČ POLOHY LISOVADLA (HORNÍ POLOHA); sheet 6: SPÍNAČ POLOHY LISOVADLA); NO 13-14 (5:13), NC 21-22 (6:16); roller lever; place:
S28 [sure] clamp plate sensor (SNÍMAČ PLECHU LISOVADLA; red ink on sheet 1 "– Д. пресса с пластиной"); NO 13-14, diamond (proximity) actuator; OM list 10.1: Telemecanique XCK-A 110;
place: machine; device row: sheet 5, column 14
XC2 [?] table-cabinet interconnection (PROPOJENÍ STŮL–ROZVADĚČ); pins 1-9 used; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 5-6, column 11; 01-08
PLC [sure] COMPACT PLC: inputs and outputs of sheet 8 (COMPACT PLC); B&R COMPACT P.L.C., 16 inputs / 14 outputs 24 V DC (photo 144328); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 8, column 01-05
K1 [sure] switches ~48 V to Y3 (air cushion) (POMOCNÁ RELÉ K1 – ŘÍZENÍ Y3); photo: F. Lütze relay, 1 changeover 11-12-14; coil voltage not read (24 V DC from the PLC, estimated); OM
list 10.2: RE6-0011; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 5, column 15
K2 [sure] feed-cut interlock (BLOKOVÁNÍ POSUV-ŘEZ) (POMOCNÁ RELÉ K2 – BLOKOVÁNÍ POSUV-ŘEZ); photo: F. Lütze relay as K1, changeover 11-12-14; coil voltage not read (24 V DC from the
PLC, estimated); OM list 10.2: RE6-0011; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 5-6, column 16; 17
- Adast Maxima MS 115 PS (serial 578.0009, 1998), control circuits: knife-lock magnet Y01, clamp brake Y14, hydraulics magnet Y11, cut clutch Y10, PLC field signals, relays K1 and K2.
- Redrawn from the wiring set 568-70.9001 SCHEMA ZAPOJENÍ (MS 80 PS,DS MS 115 PS,DS), sheet 5; columns and zones as printed.

- Marks: dashed line or [?] = unclear (on-site check list, spec/control.md); contacts in the off state as printed; end names 1/2 of lamps, RC parts and diodes are this redraw's names (1 = feed end, 2 = return end).
